newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire army chief seeks control of supplies.
newsitem.headline: Zaire army chief seeks control of supplies.

text.p: Zaire's armed forces chief of staff urged the government on Wednesday to take care of the needs of its soldiers and asked for full control of the army's logistics.

General Mahele Lieko Bokoungo also urged Zaire's notoriously ill-disciplined soldiers to refrain from looting -- a practice which has alientated them from local Zaireans and worked in favour of rebels advancing in the east and south.
"You, those in power, take care of the fate of our soldiers," he said in a statement which asked the government to take charge of the army "in that sense" and was read by a fellow officer.
"He demanded that the acquisition and management of logistics of the armed forces should henceforth be the responsibility of the army," the statement added.
In comments to the media afterwards Mahele himself, appointed by President Mobutu Sese Seko in December, urged soldiers not to go on the rampage.
His remarks were the first since a January 20 army counter-offensive flopped in the face of rebels advances on several fronts.
